response.reason: The item is clearly an industrial lockstitch sewing machine with table and motor, a type that can be priced even though the specific brand/model claim is unverifiable and working condition is unproven; it is priced at worst case (non-working, basic clutch motor, no accessories) until the requested proof is supplied.
